html:
Question 3
?

Given that the random variable X has the probability density function f(x)=3x2π(1+x6),x∈(−∞,∞),

find the cumulative distribution function F(x).

a
F(x)=arctan⁡(x3)π+1
b
F(x)=arctan⁡(x3)π+π2
c
F(x)=arctan⁡(x3)π+12
d
F(x)=arctan⁡(x3)π−π2
e
F(x)=arctan⁡(x3)π−12
